rosie.name: Rosie
rosie.personality: Brave, curious, energetic; first to say yes to an adventure; keeps the group together and always checks everyone is OK.
rosie.strength: Courage and leadership — she has a compass and a map in her backpack and always finds the way.
rosie.look: Rust-orange fur, white face markings and cheek patches, dark brown arms and legs, bushy ringed tail, teal scarf, little yellow backpack.

voice.style: Bright, confident, clear; speaks in short excited bursts.

rosie.movement: Purposeful march, points the way, fists on hips when proud.
rosie.joke: Her map is always upside down at first.

pudding.name: Pudding
pudding.personality: Silly, goofy, loves snacks and puns; turns mistakes into laughs; very loyal and huggable.
pudding.strength: Makes everyone laugh when they're worried — and he's surprisingly strong.
pudding.look: Round lavender hippo, big soft snout, tiny ears, two little teeth, rainbow propeller beanie that spins when he's excited.

voice.style: Goofy, bouncy, a bit slower, laughs a lot (hee-hee!).

pudding.joke: Always hungry; his propeller spins when he's excited.

ollie.name: Ollie
ollie.personality: Thoughtful, curious about how things work, loves puzzles and facts; a bit of a perfectionist.
ollie.strength: Solves puzzles and spots clues nobody else sees.
ollie.look: Sky-blue owlet, heart-shaped pale face, ear tufts, big round glasses, red bowtie, cream chest with chevrons.

voice.style: Gentle British accent, precise, says 'Hmm…' before ideas.

ollie.movement: Pushes his glasses up, taps his chin with a wing, hops when excited.
ollie.joke: His calculations are always right except about snacks.

clover.name: Clover
clover.personality: Sweet, kind, notices feelings; sometimes nervous, but finds her courage when friends need her.
clover.strength: Super hearing with her long ears, and kindness that calms everyone down.
clover.look: Cream bunny with very long ears (one floppy), pink nose, mint hoodie, little daisy clip on her ear, fluffy tail.

voice.style: Soft, gentle, a little breathy; slows down when nervous.

clover.movement: Small careful steps, holds her ears when nervous, little hops when happy.

ziggy.name: Ziggy
ziggy.personality: Super playful, never stops moving, races ahead, counts everything out loud; huge heart.
ziggy.strength: Speed and climbing — gets to high places nobody else can reach.
ziggy.look: Chocolate-brown monkey, peach face and belly, long curly tail, red sneakers, yellow lightning-bolt headband.

voice.style: Fast, high, excited; repeats words: 'Ready? Ready! READY!'

ziggy.movement: Bounces in place, cartwheels, swings by his tail.
ziggy.joke: Races ahead and has to zoom back.

narrator.style: Warm storyteller, used sparingly (episode open/close only).
